articles.title: Injective asks SEC to allow order books for tokenized stock trading
articles.snippet: The regulator's rules favor one type of blockchain trading system, leaving platforms built on Injective out, the developer said. It wants the SEC to open stock trading to order-book systems.

articles.title: Bitcoin tops $61,000 as Nasdaq futures extend Wednesday’s rebound
articles.snippet: U.S. equity futures extended Wednesday’s rebound after markets closed for Thanksgiving, with AI infrastructure stocks leading premarket gains.

articles.title: Monero suffers biggest single-day slide in over 5 months. Here’s why
articles.snippet: Monero (XMR) crashed over 11% on Thursday, its biggest drop since early June. Back-to-back exchange delistings seem to have catalyzed the price slide.

articles.title: Ethereum's much-awaited Glamsterdam upgrade cleared for December test. Here's what to know
articles.snippet: Developers have agreed to keep the planned storage charges despite concerns about some existing smart contracts, ending seven weeks of delays to the next major test.

articles.title: A tiny payment can expose the IP address behind a bitcoin wallet, developer finds
articles.snippet: A Bitcoin Core contributor found that the wallet's habit of resending stuck payments lets anyone link an address to the computer watching it, for under 35 cents.
